row: Dr. Muhammad Awais Sidhu (DVM) | Veterinary Doctor

Welcome to the official channel of Dr. Muhammad Awais Taib Sidhu (DVM, RVMP). I run Sidhu Vet Clinic in Bahawalnagar, Pakistan. I work as a veterinary doctor, surgeon, and dairy consultant with 8 years of experience in dairy farm management and fieldwork across Pakistan. I am a veterinary doctor and dairy consultant with hands-on experience managing commercial dairy farms. I created this channel to share my work and knowledge with the veterinary community, dairy vets, and veterinary students.

I have managed new startup dairy projects at Ibrahim Poultry Traders and Montgomery Protein Pvt. Ltd. I also worked at Interloop Pvt. Ltd. Dairy, Sheikhupura, and Al Noor Dairy Farm, Multan.
